_comment: Model profiles, keyed by model name (for llama.cpp, the name llama-server reports: model_alias, usually the GGUF filename). Copy the example to model_defaults.json (gitignored). label/provider: shown in the model picker. generation_mode/prompt_template: the model's own format, used when a rhizome leaves its template on 'auto' (the default). logit_bias: applied under any explicit value, recorded in each node's sampling_params. bos_tokens: how many <|begin_of_text|> the model sees (default 1). Sun 1.0.1: +ln 386 on eot restores end-of-turn mass her untrained eot row shared with 385 twins; bos_tokens 2 because her SFT text began with <|begin_of_text|> and TRL 0.8.6 added another.
